newsitem.title: USA: Immune Response in pact with Viru-Tech.
newsitem.headline: Immune Response in pact with Viru-Tech.

text.p: The Immune Response Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to develop and distribute its Remune drug in South America and Central America through Viru-Tech Ltd.
Remune is a drug that fights the HIV virus by stimulating the Immune system. The company hopes the product will be an entirely new weapon against HIV that complements anti-HIV drugs now available.
Immune Response said in a statement Viru-Tech has bought $3 million of its stock at a price of $12.77 which reflected a 50 percent premium over the market price.

Viru-Tech will also be responsible for the cost of any clinical trials that may be needed to commercialize Remune in the territory. Immune Response said it will provide Remune for use in any required clinical trials.
